For uncertain or creative work, distinguish known, provisional, discoverable and judgment-owned inputs. An unknown answer still has prerequisites, but the final idea is not a prerequisite of exploration. Use supported alternatives and methods that fit the uncertainty without inventing approvals, briefs, idea counts, scoring systems or research exhaustion. Mechanize preparation, faithful constraints, identity, permissions and handoffs; preserve model or human responsibility for interpretation, perception, causal reasoning, novelty, suitability, craft and taste. Retain several contract-valid outcomes and visible disagreement where justified. Inspect available authorized visual, audio, browser, tool and other modalities directly when required; do not replace them with text, hashes or simulated perception. Physical smell, taste, touch and measurements require actual authorized people or instruments when the claim needs them.

Resolve vague meaning through the existing use-case and decision owners: establish the real outcome/context and alternate interpretations; retrieve definitions and material facts; make observable requirements and fixed/bounded/open choices explicit; trace actors, objects, interfaces and state; assign methods, capable checks and residual judgment; test competing interpretations, falsifiers, failure and recovery; then bind the decision and propagate it. Retain purpose, source force, conditions, expected evidence, allowed variation, uncertainty, versions and invalidation in the compact record. Use relevant requirement, design, causal, formal or experimental methods for their actual contribution, not to populate another framework. Preserve mathematical limits: finite cases and interpretation review do not prove a universally unique meaning or deterministic judgment. Test domain-name substitution and domain-term removal for lost specificity rather than accepting generic profiles.

For every required quality, choose an observable property, capable evidence and responsible judgment that match the real outcome. Review correctness, grounding, repeatability, intelligence, creativity, craftsmanship, judgment, taste, usability, safety, accessibility, maintainability and scalability where applicable; retain other promised qualities. Distinguish fixed requirements, bounded choices and valuable open variation. Calibrate evaluators with known good/bad and held-out or independent cases; investigate disagreement and sensitivity. Preserve uncertainty and contextual judgment rather than a universal taste score, arbitrary winner or composite average. An inapplicability decision needs the exact source condition and concrete domain evidence; unknown, absent capability, cost, inconvenience or an unperformed test is unfinished work.

The human-study and human-work matrix is mandatory for this factory and every generated or updated skill, including agent primary audiences and machine-facing operations. The existing domain-research, use-case, decision and evaluation workflows must load and use relevant current selections through explicit public Mise parameters and the declared Mastra workflow. Assign definitions, reading, writing, selection, judgment, verification, validation, maintenance and acceptance to actual owners. Bind canonical versioned inventories/resources and their source identities, definitions, hierarchies, readable links, licenses, mappings, evidence, conflicts, unknowns and extensions. Keep large inventories at their resource owners; this body carries the governing method and required initial selections. Missing resources, ignored input, bypassed use or a fixed shortlist presented as complete coverage blocks factory/output acceptance.

Use complementary complete applicable starting inventories: [OECD fields of research](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2015/10/frascati-manual-2015_g1g57dcb/9789264239012-en.pdf), [ILO ISCO occupations](https://isco.ilo.org/en/isco-08/), [UN ICATUS everyday activities](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/demographic-social/time-use/icatus-2016/), the [O*NET content model](https://www.onetcenter.org/content.html) with [versioned data and attribution](https://www.onetcenter.org/database.html), and [NIST's human-centered AI use taxonomy](https://www.nist.gov/publications/ai-use-taxonomy-human-centered-approach). Research classifications do not enumerate every human mechanism; paid occupations do not cover all work; occupational population data do not predict an individual's abilities or preferences; current-resolving identifiers are not immutable snapshots. Retain complete declared hierarchies, unmapped items, overlap, interdisciplinary work, source-defined other categories and named sourced or unresolved extensions. No closed taxonomy proves all present or future fields are known.

Extend discovery to relevant sensory, physiological, cognitive, learning, emotional, social, ergonomic, accessibility, linguistic, cultural, economic, organizational, artistic, ethical, historical and physical/material fields. Include research, teaching, communication, creation across media, planning, coordination, engineering, making, repair, care, service, culinary, civic, domestic, recreational and emerging activities. These are discovery prompts, not a requirement to activate every field. Identify the actual people, task, artifact/experience, purpose, medium, setting, abilities/access needs, expertise, language, culture and time horizon from authorized evidence. Do not infer individual preferences from demographic membership or collect sensitive data merely to fill the representation. Distinguish producer capability from recipient perception, comprehension, decision, task success, learning, comfort, aesthetics, emotion, trust, originality and longer-term effects.

Represent arbitrary finite unordered selections, ordered sequences, repetitions, groupings and higher-order interactions across study concepts, work activities, people/context, outcomes, choices, constraints, evidence and judgments. Preserve meaningful order and multiplicity. Use exact, alias, broader/narrower, related and approximate mappings with the distinctions in [SKOS](https://www.w3.org/TR/skos-reference/); no RDF service is required. Symbolic selectors identify the versioned inventories, selection rule, grouping, ordering, conditions and explicit execution bounds. Every concrete member remains addressable without another schema. Keep parsing, captured identifier resolution, filtering, canonical serialization and enumeration reproducible, including comparator, locale, schema and source versions. Canonicalize only semantically unordered structures. Prefer supported standard combinatorial iterators and lazy records over stored cross-products or model calls per cell; measure their input-pool memory as well as output size. Representability grants no usefulness, truth, permission or tested status.

Use the matrix to make actual choices: map the brief and challenge its first categories; pose the exact property-to-human-outcome question and label mechanisms as hypotheses; read relevant authoritative standards, reviews and original studies including counterevidence; connect each applicable finding to a concrete choice and transfer rationale; assign the mechanism, model and human duties with capable checks; then inspect and revise the actual artifact against the intended outcome. Record publication/revision, population, setting, task, medium, comparison, measures, effect, uncertainty and access limits where available. Distinguish normative standards, causal results, associations, theories, documented practice and inference. Freshness alone is not relevance; separately supported choices do not prove their combined effect. Refresh material gaps and changed selections without loading every global cell into every context.

Keep mechanical predicates, research evidence, model assessment, authentic human evidence and physical observations distinct. Actual permission, personal preference, expert craft review, subjective comparison and observed task performance answer different questions. Relevant research supports bounded transfer, not guaranteed appreciation or measured improvement in this artifact. Ease can differ from learning; productive practice may serve the outcome. Novelty and diversity need their own assessment; one story experiment does not establish general creative uplift. More agents, reviewers or checkpoints do not prove better collaboration. Model judges need relevant held-out or authentic human comparison and bias/context checks before claiming to predict human evaluation. Predeclare suitable comparisons, participants, order, sample, measures and uncertainty for required human evidence; do not invent universal sample sizes. Missing required evidence stays unresolved through the authorized handoff. Optional unavailable studies permit only narrower truthful claims.

## Mise task graph

Mise owns the public command surface, pinned environment and outer prerequisites. Mastra owns each delegated domain workflow and its supported control/state/recovery. Tested scripts perform repeatable leaves and exact predicates directly in that environment. Caller-controlled models own residual meaning, causal reasoning, research interpretation, perception and creative capability. Humans supply their assigned authentic evidence and decisions; the host owns identity, permission and supported communication. Inventory the actual actors, tools, external systems and governed resources before assigning duties. Keep one owner per scheduling, retry, cache, state, cleanup and protected effect. Put an explicit handoff between these owners; never recursively invoke competing Mise graphs from workflow steps. A mandatory Mastra workflow must execute the skill's actual capability, including the factory's own domain work, rather than wrapping bookkeeping or a generic proxy.

| User command | Existing public route and protected result |
| --- | --- |
| `help` | Show this grammar and a one-line result for each command. Use `mise run validate` for the [complete help example](examples/example-help.md). |
| `new <prompt>` | Resolve the name, description, scope, audience and destination, then `mise run new -- --name <name> --description "<description>" --scope <user-or-project> --dest <destination> --plan`. Review its exact rendered bytes and repeat the same flags with `--review <review.json>` in place of `--plan`. A scaffold is not an accepted skill. |
| `update <path> <prompt>` | Freeze the source with `mise run plan-standardize -- <path>`, then perform the authorized smallest-owner change through its current public route and validate the complete target. Preserve domain purpose and accepted behavior. |
| `standardize <path>` | Use `mise run plan-standardize -- <path>` and the source's supported standardization path. Standardization changes shape/execution while preserving capability and authorized customizations. |
| `standardize-target <path> <profile>` | Run `mise run --output interleave standardize-target -- <path> --profile <profile>` with the resolved `--scope` when needed and save its final complete JSON plan report, following any prerequisite diagnostics. Review exact inputs, rendered files, candidate body and each file through the current ledger; repeat with `--apply --plan-file <plan.json> --review <review.json>`. The review binds the plan digest, source context, initial body review and every planned-file declaration. Load [the standardization example](examples/example-standardization.md) through this task for the full plan/review, rejection and recovery sequence. Pending declarations do not establish domain acceptance. |
| `import <source> <destination>` | Run `mise run audit-source-corpus -- <source>` and `mise run plan-standardize -- <source>`; classify and preserve the complete source before the supported separate-destination conversion. An import command in this grammar does not invent a missing script interface. |
| `variant <source> <user-or-project>` | Use `mise run variant` with the [variant workflow][variants] for scope plan, candidate, domain review, `accept --preview`, complete publication/ledger review and guarded acceptance. Both directions require actual adaptation and independent validation; refresh is explicit. |
| `validate <path>` | `mise run validate-target -- <path>` checks the target. Use `--inspect-legacy` only for untouched legacy inspection; it cannot accept a changed output with missing required fields. |
| `eval <path>` | `mise run eval-target -- <path>` checks the evaluation artifacts, then execute the actual declared cases through their supported runner. A schema checker has not run those cases. |
| `refresh-registry-lineage <skill...>` | `mise run refresh-registry-lineage -- <skill...>` refreshes owned lineage only after accepted registry changes and current prerequisite proof. |
| `doctor` | `mise run doctor` reports actual supported readiness and the exact missing prerequisite. Its checks establish only their stated predicates. |

Each actual supported situation has one explicit default route, its genuine alternatives and failure branch. Resolve tool readiness, current public interfaces, explicit user choices and material domain fit from the actual host and owners; do not assume availability from a name, install, model claim or preference. Honor relevant established preferences; inference remains provisional and grants no installation, access, communication, storage or effect authority. Keep client/account/project/callable-tool bindings and preference resolution in the integration layer. Preserve every available authorized capability needed by the outcome, including direct visual/audio inspection, web research, browser/computer interaction, tool calls and multimodal creation. Block only the affected unsupported consumer. Mandatory tools remain mandatory under their conditions; one user's binding cannot become another skill's host assumption.

Pass long prompts and agentic inputs through `mise run agentic-request -- --request <file-or-dash> --runner <executable> --runner-args-json <array>`. The dispatcher first automatically captures its current SKILL.md as `body`, with path, digest and text. The actual caller selects executable authority and argument boundaries outside untrusted request data. Bind the completed use case, outcome, domain terms, prompt, SKILL.md dependencies and primitives to their current digests, domain role, contribution, relevance and proof. Validate file/stdin input and actual UTF-8 content snapshots in `body.text`, `use_case.text`, `skills[].text` and `context[].text`, then deliver the typed envelope over stdin without shell interpolation. Required ledger, matrix and other resources need explicit parameters and actual consumer use through the declared public/Mastra route. Text snapshots do not prove binary-media consumption or model understanding. Preserve non-text modalities through the real capable runner. Structure, bounded whole-phrase matching, digests, process exit and output schemas do not establish relevance, correct choices or domain success.

For each consumed package, tool, language, snippet or integration, define the skill-specific result and proof; inspect the consumed artifact/version, public API, configuration and relevant transitive behavior; derive the domain design; choose the smallest supported composition; implement its real interface with native tooling; exercise it; prove the result and seams; then propagate independent support and invalidate affected proof. At the existing decision owner, distinguish what the dependency supplies, what the skill implements and residual judgment. Specify material argument/return shapes, units, encoding, nullability, defaults, validation timing, errors, effects, state lifetime, concurrency, retries, cancellation and cleanup. Use current first-party documentation, releases/source, installed types/schema and runtime probes. Preserve working languages/APIs. Distinguish public contracts, examples, internals and unreleased changes; unavailable source needs authorized probes and stated limits. Upstream success is component evidence. Never invent an API, depend accidentally on internals, substitute engines, suppress failure or redefine the goal.

Freeze compatible published versions during outcome work. Declare the actual runtime and exact package/tool pins, native package-manager manifests/locks, peer/transitive requirements and supported platform/ABI, configuration, environment, credentials and services. Run shared Python helpers in isolated uv environments bound to Mise’s resolved Python path, without ancestor-project selection or uv interpreter downloads. Preserve domain-specific environments and reconcile customized runtime declarations. A Mise tool lock does not replace application dependency locking; installation does not prove import or behavior. Research unfamiliar languages through their official practice and native checks without adding unused toolchains. Distinguish stable packages from experimental or beta features; use a consequential optional feature only with actual need, authority, activation, compatibility, rejection/recovery evidence and a supported fallback. Store versions and capability/non-use decisions at their existing owners. Unavailable or unproved mandatory behavior is a blocker, not a replacement permission.

Every task declares dependencies, including an empty list for a true root, and reaches CI or a public operation. Preserve outer graph guards against cycles, diamonds, duplicate or redundant paths, disconnected/unknown tasks and nested Mise calls. These rules do not prohibit valid Mastra joins, conditional branches, parallel work or bounded feedback. Inspect all effective task sources, inherited/template configuration, aliases, patterns, embedded `run`/`run_windows` task references, arguments and environment. Sibling dependency-list order is not sequence. Sequential run entries differ from a parallel task group. `wait_for` waits for an already scheduled task; it does not schedule one. Post-task subtrees run only after their parent has started, including parent failure, and do not run when a failed prerequisite prevents that start. Post tasks provide neither rollback nor crash recovery. Preserve task-environment non-inheritance and the fact that an empty child `depends` list need not clear inherited template prerequisites; verify selected-release behavior with actual probes.

Mise task includes are not model-context delivery. Usage declarations are not proof of argument forwarding. Task freshness and artifact caching are separate; bypass both when fresh baseline evidence requires it. Cache only deterministic work with complete input, tool/version, environment and output bindings, including captured randomness where appropriate. Never cache live judgment, mutable remote state or side effects as fresh proof. Preserve selected-release locking, task isolation, context/resource, MCP and skills-sync limits; native locks are not arbitrary cross-file transactions, MCP declarations are not host approval and symlink synchronization is not an independent variant. Use the native owner where it meets the actual guarantee and a tested script only for a missing guarantee. Classify every current schema-derived Mise config/task/tool primitive in the [primitive catalog and dispositions](assets/mise-primitives.json) through `mise run mise-primitives-policy`; prove useful domain application, including a useful creative composition, or source-supported non-use rather than nominal feature use.

| Required companion support | Actual boundary and conditions to preserve |
| --- | --- |
| Usage | Keep one authoritative argument definition for parsing, help, examples, completion and interface documentation. Use its supported Mise integration for explicit resources, roots, scope, variants and long-input stdin. Verify exporters and actual downstream forwarding for spaces, Unicode, empty values, repetition, quoting, shell characters and environment. Run supported spec lint/diff through Mise; grammar and effect metadata cannot establish implementation equivalence. |
| Packslip | Use selected-release manifests, signatures, artifact identity/platform/resource metadata and consumer policy where distribution needs them. A native Mise backend may meet the install role without the separate CLI; actual manifest-generation/verification roles still need their supported mechanism. Verify signer identity/key policy, bytes, project/version, expiry, rollback/withdrawal and separately claimed provenance. Decoding is not verification. Support does not authorize signing/publication or artificial binary artifacts. |
| fnox | Prefer its maintained CLI for scoped credential subprocesses through Mise; do not substitute an incomplete environment plugin. Bind provider/profile, required names, identity, scope, lease freshness and actual consumer readiness. Missing/expired/overbroad credentials block despite warning/skip behavior or ambient alternatives. Keep values, private keys, caches, proxy material and lease secrets outside portable output and persistent traces. Scoped proxy/placeholder protocols are not universal OS isolation. Cache, encrypted sync, activation and authentication retain separate limits and authority. |
| Pitchfork | Use it only for genuinely required persistent processes; finite transformations stay finite Mise work. Bind project/worktree identity, executable, working directory, ports, dependencies, pinned environment, lifetime and platform. Readiness must meet the actual consumer condition, including all required probes even when native probes accept first success. Reuse only matching healthy instances. Preserve child termination, bounded retry/health, interruption and cleanup of owned processes while leaving unrelated services intact. Autostart, listeners, schedules and host activation need actual purpose and authority. |
| hk | Reuse the existing language/domain checks with exact roots and file selection. Pin its Pkl imports to the selected release and use the built-in evaluator unless a needed feature justifies another declared evaluator. Inspect actual fix/check settings; force and prove read-only behavior when required, including an empty diff. Authorized fixes preserve staged, unstaged, untracked and unrelated work; file locks have a limited perimeter. Incremental checks do not replace whole-package or behavioral proof. Test per-directory Mise fallback and configuration-cache behavior. Installing the tool does not install hooks or agent-host integration. |

All five companions need current official feature/interface/source review and compatible supported versions; actual use stays conditional on its source-defined role. Reconcile their boundaries in the owning Mise tasks and Mastra workflow, not a new supervisor. Exact tools, lockfiles, configurations, test credentials and probes belong to each real package's declared environment. Tool support grants no global configuration, new service, credential access, signing, hooks, MCP, machine changes or variant synchronization. Use disposable, explicitly scoped resources for required tests and preserve unrelated state. Read back actual native behavior before relying on composition.

The required Mastra workflow must use compatible published artifacts and a declared managed runtime, minimal necessary TypeScript definitions/adapter and native dependency lock. Preserve existing script languages and direct leaf implementations. Inspect and map input/output/state/resume schemas, steps, composition, sequential/parallel/branch control, loops, suspension/resumption, persistence/snapshots/replay, observation, dynamic definitions, scheduling and supported engines. Optional feature non-use does not waive the workflow itself. Bind each meaningful step to real domain input, action, output, responsible judgment and failure/recovery. A one-node status wrapper that bypasses substantive workflow behavior does not establish the required capability, and extra Agent/provider infrastructure is unnecessary when the caller already supplies the runner.

Test the selected Mastra engine rather than trusting guide wording. Resolve branching discrepancies with actual all-true behavior and explicit exclusive decisions when needed; do not hide a mandatory failed requirement in a false predicate. Validate real input/output/resume boundaries: types, schema conversion and declared outputs alone are insufficient. Acceptance checks must affect the returned domain result; caught completion-callback errors cannot be the only gate. A suspended or bailed step must return before its protected effect. Persistence, snapshots and replay require suitable supported storage and recovery policy; they do not prove crash safety or exactly-once effects. Replayed/resumed effects still need current operation, identity, input and authentic approval bindings. Inspect changed definitions, missing steps and invalid resumes instead of accepting engine success as domain success.

Dynamic beta workflows need faithful supported serialization and supplied-registry resolution; generated data cannot choose arbitrary executable authority. Schedules and workers depend on the selected live host, storage, transport and endpoint controls; optional engines are neither interchangeable nor uniformly production-ready. Keep secret handling outside persistable state and verify actual filtering, exporter, retention, trace and snapshot limits. Coordinate credentials, process readiness, argument delivery, verification and checks at explicit boundaries with one retry/cleanup owner. Record the tested engine, configuration, actual semantics, unsupported cases and recovery. A queued run, timer, stored request, transport acknowledgment or process-local sleep does not establish durable work or completed human input.

**Human gate protocol.** Model: prepare the concrete artifact, permitted checks, one material question and assigned human role. Mastra: bind artifact/input/run/step/iteration/expiry and suspend before the protected effect. Host: deliver the supported request and authenticate the response. Human: supply the actual response or leave it pending. Scripts: validate identity, target and unchanged bindings; the model judges semantic content before supported resume. Use suitable state lifetime and no competing supervisor. Readback: the authentic current response or truthful pending state. Silence, time, defaults, model personas, labels and duplicate/stale replies are not approval or evidence. Revisions stale affected evidence and approvals; preserve rejection meaning without repeated pressure. Ask only when mandatory or material, reuse valid contributions, and continue eligible work while waiting.

Before choosing workflow granularity, run isolated repeatable A/B/C implementations through public Mise tasks under matching inputs, tools, models, permitted effects, outputs, checks and criteria. A is the direct Mise-to-script control. B uses meaningful Mastra domain steps with existing scripts and authorized runners. C wraps every executable script route in the inspected inventory, accounting for helpers/tests without inventing workflows. A cannot replace mandatory Mastra; B/C preserve the whole outcome. Repeat small, typical and larger workloads across success, failure, fresh/reused starts, interruption and recovery. Count setup/dependency footprint, build/import/startup, launches, serialization, snapshots/write volume, logs/traces, CPU, memory, network, model work, waits, retries, cleanup and recipient effort. Separate engine overhead and use actual counters. Select the simplest fully compliant demonstrated tradeoff; reject blanket wrapping that adds cost or weakens control/recovery. If none complies, report the exact conflict before acceptance. Inspection and upstream benchmarks do not prove these results.

## Steps

1. **Resolve the contract.** Model: read this whole body and current initial inputs; identify command, outcome, purpose, audience, scope, accepted behavior, fixed constraints, mandatory methods and sufficient proof. Use canonical records and `mise run resolve-scope`; retrieve material facts. Host: establish current identity and permissions. Readback: a source-bound contract with actual actors and consumers. Expose the complete versioned plan before action; log progress and evidence externally after every step. Branch: `help` returns the grammar; `doctor` returns its supported readiness result; otherwise continue the matching operation. Stop: pause affected work for an unmatched command, unretrievable material fact or actual authority gate; ask one concise question and keep eligible independent work moving.
2. **Establish usable prerequisites.** Model: inspect the real environment, owners/callers, tool interfaces, complete package/source inventory and dependencies. Mise: run `mise run doctor` and relevant policy routes through their owning scripts. Readback: actual readiness, version/configuration/resource bindings, authorized effects, source integrity and preserved baseline. If: a required source is inaccessible or identity differs, report expected/observed identity and stop its consumer without normalizing the source or silently accepting another baseline. Explore safely under provisional inputs only where fixed effect/acceptance gates allow it.
3. **Reconcile the governing ledger.** Model: use `mise run ledger` and its actual Mastra read/review workflow to read every authorized governing document and the entire current ledger. Reconcile source-to-record and record-to-source coverage, file roles, facets, typed relationships, applicability and domain use. Readback: exact source/body bindings, semantic review, unknowns/conflicts, owners and frozen acceptance/failure criteria. For each: add omissions without deleting parents. A mandated body rewrite finishes this foundation, authors a fresh complete candidate reconciling current contents, and validates meaning, unique ownership, dependency order, initial loading, syntax and resource routes against the whole ledger before further file development. Human: provide required clarity and same-meaning review of the concrete instructions before final acceptance, through the Human gate protocol. Authoring, pushing or initial contract validation cannot grant final acceptance; shape checks cannot replace semantic or human judgment.
4. **Freeze the executable change plan.** Model: select the smallest capable current owner, resolve the public command and prepare a versioned plan with all ordered steps, owners, inputs, resource arguments, effects, observable readbacks, failure/recovery, tests and propagation. Mise: run `mise run plan-standardize -- <source>` and retain its `baseline_digest` when a source is involved; run `mise run task-graph-policy` for the outer graph. Readback: one reviewable plan with preserved behavior, collision/ownership checks and actual dependencies. Branch: import also uses `mise run audit-source-corpus`; standardization reviews the exact profile and no-write plan; variants follow their independent plan/review/accept route. Material change requires explicit replanning, not an improvised hidden workflow.
5. **Implement the selected operation.** Mastra: execute the domain plan with existing scripts and authorized runners, preserving model capabilities and caller authority. Model: supply the assigned interpretation, creative work and judgments. Branch: use the Human gate protocol before an effect needs required input or authority. For each: perform the full before/after ledger, body and governing-document review for every file write; record its functional contribution and body integration. New skills follow tasks, CI/graph contract tests, failing behavior tests, implementation, documentation and evals; a mandated body rewrite uses the preceding foundation gate. Repeat: run `mise run test` and focused RED, GREEN, REFACTOR at each shared owner: observe failure, implement the minimum correct repair, rerun the case and affected regression within its bound. Readback: actual domain changes and supporting outputs. Reject unresolved placeholders, generic profiles, lost accepted behavior, unsupported interfaces and unauthorized source changes.
6. **Prove the integrated result.** Mise: run `mise run decision-policy`, the target's `mise run ci`, `mise run validate-target -- <path>` and `mise run eval-target -- <path>` with the actual case runner. Scripts: perform assigned checks through those routes. Model: run actual behavioral evaluations and independent outputs; inspect artifact contents, required modalities and source-to-claim support under frozen criteria. Human: perform assigned recipient tasks and required authentic reviews. Readback: exact tested inputs/revisions/bytes, domain outcomes, protected rejection and legitimate recovery, evaluator judgments and limits. If: a required check or judgment fails, repair the lowest responsible owner and invalidate its affected dependents. No factory pass can hide a failing output.
7. **Account for the invocation and any justified trial.** Model: record every public task's actual run evidence or source-supported request/domain non-use, including the checker itself. Mise: run `mise run invocation-policy -- <receipt>`. Readback: complete task accounting distinct from evidence acceptance. Branch: only after required work is accepted, an authorized improvement trial freezes a fresh baseline, evaluator, fixtures, relevant seed, environment, repetitions, time and resources; changes one named dimension; runs `mise run improvement-policy` and its real domain experiment; records keep/discard/crash outside the editable surface. Keep only material demonstrated improvement without a protected regression; otherwise restore accepted bytes and verify their digest. Do not add an open-ended loop unless the user's completion condition requires it.
8. **Maintain and deliver the accepted package.** Mise: after outcome and acceptance work concludes, run `mise run mise-primitives-update` last. Its predependency self-updates without plugins, its body refreshes the exact-release schema catalog, and its postdependency forces domain reconciliation and owned lineage refresh. Rerun `mise run ci` under the resulting binary and record its version/catalog digest. Package-manager, network or compatibility failure remains incomplete without overriding ownership. Model: coordinate authorized repository and installation owners. Readback: current dependent checks, accepted local and actual authoritative remote bytes, required CI for that revision, preserved lineage, installed discovery/invocation and independent validation. Follow the user's PR/merge/release boundaries; an unmerged proposal is not authoritative delivery. Report every retained requirement's evidence or precise incomplete state. Stop: finish at the first fully accepted result.

## Assets

Each accepted skill has one owned directory containing its matching SKILL.md, necessary support, `mise.toml`, CI, complete examples and evals. Use `mise run validate` with the [generation contract][generation] for layout and frontmatter. YAML starts at byte zero with supported fields only: name, description, license, compatibility, metadata and allowed-tools. Registry names contain 1 to 64 lowercase letters/digits with single hyphens and match the directory. Non-registry names retain `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$` at the generation owner. Descriptions are quoted, nonempty, at most 1024 characters, begin with `Use when`, and state applicability/search terms rather than the procedure. License defaults to MIT unless the user directs otherwise. Metadata values are strings; author is Kiren Srinivasan. New versions start at `"0.1.0"`; skills own versions independently. Preserve valid metadata and scope/audience. Optional compatibility is 1 to 500 characters; allowed-tools is a string with supported specification semantics. Parse YAML and reject duplicate keys, malformed fields and invalid types.

The body and its template stay below 200 lines and 100000 characters, in the seven H2 sections Outcome, Motivation, Evidence, Mise task graph, Steps, Assets and Evals. Other Markdown has at most 200 physical lines. Keep each wrappable paragraph or list item on one physical line with required blank lines; frontmatter, headings, tables and code blocks retain valid syntax. Keep core rules and initial context here; route optional detail with its precise trigger and backlink instead of hiding requirements for size. Every resource reference, including custom roots, names its owning public `mise run <task>` in the same block or enclosing section. Link actual implementation owners descriptively while executable instructions use public tasks. `mise run lint-writing` applies the [writing rules](references/writing-rules.md): result first, simple active language, one idea per sentence/topic, defined consistent terms and dependency order. Same-meaning human review must confirm clarity and completeness; lexical lint cannot replace it.

All code, tests, configurations, templates and embedded snippets follow every applicable goal/repository rule, including non-coding rules. Load the [code rules](references/code-rules.md) through `mise run lint-code`. Keep at most 200 code lines per file, 30 owned lines per function/class and nesting depth 3, counted from the test declaration in tests. No work markers, mocks, stubs or placeholder branches ship. Scripts support `--help` with usage, exit codes and a real example; accept flags or stdin, send stdout data and stderr diagnostics, and use 0 for success, 1 for failed checks and 2 for bad usage. Preserve encoding, numeric, error, concurrency, resource, platform and safe-rerun semantics. Use native formatters/analyzers/test tools under declared Mise-managed runtimes; missing required tools block acceptance, with no ambient fallback. `mise run check-runtime` installs locked dependencies before strict owned TypeScript checks; dependency declarations are excluded. `lint-code` then checks syntax, size and nesting. `test` depends on this chain.

Apply every relevant principle from all six [Ponytail procedures and source](https://github.com/dietrichgebert/ponytail), including shared rules, native guidance, examples, adapters and rule-copy/version checks, after inspecting the current revision and recording relevant changes from the verified baseline. Inventory/deduplicate principles and map applicability, owner and proof; explain non-coding exclusions and conflicts. After full caller tracing, stop at the first adequate rung: omit speculative work, reuse existing code, standard library, native feature, installed dependency, one clear expression, then minimum correct code. Preserve calibration, edge cases, maintainability, required workflow behavior and every test/safeguard. Review with `delete`, `stdlib`, `native`, `yagni` and `shrink`, naming location, justified cut, replacement and evidence. Diff/audit/debt/benchmark reports do not themselves authorize edits. Record a real accepted tradeoff with a language-valid `ponytail:` limit/revisit comment or existing adjacent decision record; flag missing triggers and exclude dependency/build products. Use actual baselines for savings and authoritative sources for copy parity.

Use one existing record owner per fact or procedure. The [use-case record][use-case], checked by `mise run use-case-policy`, binds domain terms, actors, objects, actions, states, invariants, variants, interfaces, authority, failures, recovery, evidence, time, resources, qualities, exclusions and each task's outcome/motivation/progress/proof/applicability. The [lifecycle record](assets/primitive-lifecycle.json), checked by `mise run primitive-lifecycle-policy`, covers every aspect/primitive from discovery, research, experiment and decision through creation, inspection, update, validation, acceptance, restoration, deprecation and retirement, with actual tasks, domain value and prevented failures. The [decision record](assets/decision-records.json), checked by `mise run decision-policy`, records each material program/model/human choice, fit, owner, inputs, effects, criteria, falsifier, judgment and recovery. Extend these schemas and source-mapping/lineage owners for ledger, matrix and dependency use; do not regenerate valid domain data as canned prose, overwrite unrepresented extensions, create duplicate catalogs or promote a preservation string to semantic review.

Before new work, use `mise run source-corpus` with [registry guidance](references/registry.md) and the [source-shape corpus](assets/source-shape-corpus.json) to find an existing owner, starting with an available starting-point skill for its declared job. `mise run new` owns the [body template](assets/skill-template.md), scaffolding and [creation example](examples/example-new-skill.md). Every output needs one complete actual example per grammar command and its likely failure: the guess removed, user's words, visible reply, commands with observed output/exit codes and full created contents. Never invent results. Update affected examples in the same commit as a changed rule, path, schema or command. Use `mise run doctor` for the [readiness failure example](examples/example-doctor.md), matching target tasks for validation examples, `mise run evals` for [evaluation authoring](references/eval-authoring.md) and evaluation resources, and `mise run lint-placeholders` for placeholder evidence. Initial seeds remain blocked until real domain contents and proof replace them.

For updates, standardization and imports preserve the frozen owned-file baseline, domain capability, valid scope/audience, source outcome/proof/boundaries/forbidden outcomes/mandatory methods and accepted customizations. Reject owned symlinks before reading/hashing and exclude runtime caches, installed dependencies, bytecode and tool state from package identity. An optional source adapter recognizes actual supported formats without treating formats as agents; classify every candidate and stop affected writes for unknown shape/ownership, collision or hidden host assumptions. Translate portable capability into SKILL.md, repository guidance into AGENTS.md and integration-owned host context into its supported `.agents/` owner through the reviewed `mise run plan-standardize` route. Remove host-only fields, paths, permissions and runtime assumptions from the destination without losing capability. Source bytes remain unchanged unless explicit in-place migration is authorized. Standardization preserves descriptive owner links and the single body workflow without appending a competing process. Do not bind destinations to one agent product, harness, vendor or model.

For scope variants, use `mise run variant` and the [scope workflow][variants] with the matching [project example](examples/example-variant-project.md) or [user example](examples/example-variant-user.md). Derive a separate independent skill unless in-place adaptation is explicit. User-to-project adapts actual project context, conventions, interfaces, constraints and proof. Project-to-user separates reusable behavior from project-specific assumptions, exposes required parameters and succeeds in at least two materially different projects. Preserve source identity/bytes, both scopes, purpose, accepted behavior, privacy, output audience and independent maintenance. Reverse conversion is not byte restoration. A requested refresh compares immutable recorded source and target baselines with current source and intentional customizations, resolves conflicts before writes, and verifies safe reruns and correct lineage. Naming, placement or synchronized symlinks cannot establish adaptation or independence; never force unrelated registry migrations.

Propagate the complete accepted operating contract through every template, copy/fill list, standardizer replacement, contract repair, source import, both variant directions, explicit in-place adaptation and requested refresh. Include core body/ledger rules, current definitions and checkers, audience/key, matrix and actual resources, all dependency layers, human handoff, domain Mastra/companions, language/software methods, anti-pattern rules and required proofs. Compare copies to the current canonical owner/version as well as one another; identical stale copies fail, and customized checkers need an explicit preserved-contract comparison rather than blind overwrite. Each actual generated or updated package runs and validates in its declared clean environment without the factory installation, checkout, private source path, ambient package, credentials or shared run state. Preserve independently justified customization and propagate fixes at the smallest responsible owner.

## Evals

Freeze the applicable source requirements, expected results, allowed variation, falsifiers, fixtures, evaluators, failure/recovery observations and comparison boundaries before implementation. Treat every substantive parent and applicable component as required even when a derived checklist omits it. Use disposable isolated real packages and authorized test credentials, preserving unrelated files, processes, Git state, services and secrets. Exercise actual public paths and final consumers. Use available authorized models, including less capable models where available, repeated fresh contexts and matched with-skill/without-skill baselines; record real identities and sample limits outside portable content. Distinguish a single pass, retry-selected success and all-observed reliability. No finite test or graph proves every real-world dependency, universal language coverage, unique meaning or absence of model variation.

Use `mise run evals` with [local cases](evals/evals.json), [local trigger queries](evals/trigger-queries.json) and the applicable registry [manifest](evals/manifest.json), [cases](evals/cases.json), [trigger cases](evals/trigger-cases.json), [contract](evals/contract.md), [rubric](evals/rubric.md), [speed budgets](evals/speed-budgets.json) and [source lineage](evals/source-lineage.json). Keep at least four realistic domain cases with prompts, expected output and verifiable assertions, positive/negative activation and near misses. Registry lineage contains real source SHA-256 values and a public version equal to the skill's independently owned version. Use actual current manifests for case counts and versions. Target schema validation does not execute behavior. Run required `validate`, `lint-writing`, `lint-code`, `lint-placeholders`, research/use-case/lifecycle/task/decision/primitive/invocation policies and complete `ci`, with zero problems where their interfaces require it. `doctor` reports `ready: true` and `mode: mise` only for its actual checks; these outputs never substitute for domain readiness, artifact review or required recipient evidence.

Prove coverage and effect guards with rejected mandatory failures and valid recovery: missing source/span/clause/condition; weakened output rule or stale canonical/copy agreement; wrong requirement/package/revision/source/input/dependency/evaluator/owner/artifact bindings; changed reviewed bytes; false non-applicability; bypassed direct/alternate/retry/resume prerequisites; missing or ignored initial/conditional resources; swallowed errors or misleading zero-exit/workflow/callback results; invalidated caches; failing outputs behind passing factory checks; forged, wrong-target, duplicate, expired or replayed human input; altered thresholds after failure; and cached, descriptive, simulated or fixture evidence presented as fresh actual behavior. Inspect non-effects, preserved accepted state and process status. Restore legitimate prerequisites and observe the real consumer succeed. Record atomicity/isolation limits and routes outside the tested host perimeter honestly.

Exercise all source-defined families together and separately: scope/audience combinations and legacy versus changed acceptance; true domain meaning and tool choice; all activity/ownership assignments and handoffs; dependency readiness, selected intermediates, creative alternatives and invalidation; linked-source support and actual resource consumption; matrix vocabulary integrity, exact bounded selection counts/round trips, order/repeats/grouping/higher-order context, lazy memory and explicit budgets; research transfer, conflicting/unknown evidence and human claims; every required companion's actual failure and composition boundaries; Mastra branching/schema/status, suspension, storage/replay, privacy, dynamic/schedule compatibility and independent output behavior; authentic human gates; A/B/C granularity; different and unfamiliar language families; wrong-version/API/configuration examples; variants/refresh and customization; useful recipient results and WorkSlop rejection. Large-space interaction tests report their strength, omitted combinations and sampling; pairwise coverage cannot replace a required higher-order or exhaustive claim. Include complete deterministic, variable/creative and exploration-led worked traces with bound inputs, real resources, assigned checks, actual results and remaining judgment.

Review actual defaults, architecture, code, configuration, interfaces, data, prompts, docs, tests, evaluators and maintenance for these expandable anti-pattern families: wrong goal/audience; speculative abstraction/generality; incomplete simplicity; ceremonial tool/features; lost determinism or creativity; competing ownership/composition; hidden context/portability assumptions; stale or leaked data/state; masked error/authority failures; misleading speed/measurement; proxy proof/evaluation; false human evidence; broken maintenance/reuse; and difficult language/instructions. For each applicable pattern retain its trigger, why it is tempting, violated requirement, observable failure, smallest compliant alternative, owner, detection and positive/negative examples. Separate definite violations from review signals. Test technically sound implementations that defeat the task and observe actual agent choices and usable artifacts, not a statement of understanding. Research examples are candidate failure mechanisms, not proof of a defect. Preserve justified abstractions, caches, parallelism, tests, documentation, human review and mandatory Mastra instead of replacing a contextual rule with its opposite blanket ban.

Close the smallest ready functional path after its required gates and prerequisites through its required validation and authorized delivery while keeping independent eligible work moving. Tie infrastructure, ledger maintenance, reporting and packaging to a concrete unmet obligation, its actual consumer and the gap that existing mechanisms cannot fill. Do not repeat supporting work on unchanged inputs while a required functional path is ready. Reuse still-valid proof only with current artifact, dependency, environment and evaluator bindings and no required repetition; run affected checks plus every required integrated check. If progress stalls, use actual failure and timing evidence to change the ineffective path without dropping scope or proof. Report implemented behavior, validated behavior and accepted obligations separately. State the denominator and weighting behind a measured completion percentage; label an informal estimate and its uncertainty. Preserve every required full ledger/source/body read, source judgment, human proof and purposeful creative iteration. Keep speed claims pending until matched accepted end-to-end trials support them. Creation and updates must propagate this policy into the output body and verify the actual produced package. Standardization reads the current canonical efficiency paragraph from the template; a differing existing paragraph requires an explicit reviewed migration and must not be silently replaced. Measure complete factory invocation, creation/update, generated-skill invocation and maintenance outcomes separately. Capture cold/warm discovery, full loading, transport, preparation, task/model work, waits, retries, recovery, verification and recipient effort. Measure relevant time, tokens/context, CPU, memory, storage, network, cache, processes, concurrency, accelerators, money and human attention or record source-supported non-use. Compare matched accepted baselines and investigate variance, failed attempts and evaluator disagreement. Derive workload/scalability limits from actual evidence, including combinatorial input-pool memory; do not invent budgets from an unrelated benchmark. Keep faster behavior only when the whole result and every protected dimension remain valid. Invocation accounting, reader microbenchmarks, package checks and upstream tests establish their own limited properties.

Accept only when every applicable requirement is implemented and supported by fresh sufficient bound evidence across the factory, required outputs, supported operations and integrated use. Bind exact subject/revision/owned bytes, source, actual input/resources/selected output, dependencies/environment/engine/schema/evaluator, authority, command or model/human protocol, observed domain result/effect, artifact contents/provenance and responsible judgment. Preserve missing, failed, stale, blocked, passed and justified non-use through the existing status owners; a task's `run`/`inapplicable` accounting is not evidence acceptance. No mandatory skipped, indeterminate, unproved, missing or unapproved reduction can be averaged away. Actual human/physical requirements remain pending when unavailable. Keep publication/installation authority, attribution, license, independent version and read-only path-confined repository MCP boundaries intact; do not add telemetry, credentials, network/write tools or unrequested integrations.

Return the source-required decision trail: preserved purpose and audience; location/issue/change/owner/proof; core body and reading/action guide; complete requirement/operation/output coverage; dependency discovery/order/readiness/invalidation and actual enforcement predicate/perimeter/rejection/recovery; meanings and allowed variation; tools/resources/versions/features; Mastra engine, human handoff and A/B/C; language/Ponytail/software interfaces; all four matrix coverage classes, real participants and transfer limits; anti-patterns and justified alternatives; cold/warm time/tokens/resources/recipient effort/scalability; variants, lineage, maintenance, installed/remote identity and required CI. Separate source inspection, component tests, integration, model assessment, authentic human/physical evidence and inference. Identify any missing prerequisite and smallest recovery action while continuing eligible work. A blocker, finished subtask, budget exhaustion, queued work, local edit, pushed branch or old remote CI is not completion.

name: skill-factory
description: "Use when a workflow or capability must become a new agent skill, when an existing skill must be updated or standardized without losing its purpose, when a user-level or project-level variant is needed, or when a skill needs validation, evaluation, scaffolding, scripts, tests, or a Mise task graph."

  author: Kiren Srinivasan
  version: "0.5.1"
  scope: "user"
